gold.question: Along the process flow path from E-7-2 to GV-47-2, which item has the lowest maximum allowable pressure according to its datasheet? Give the value for every item on the path that has a datasheet.

candidate: The flow path from E-7-2 to GV-47-2 passes through E-7-2, LV-7-1, P-26-1, E-26-1, P-26-2, BV-26-1, P-26-3, LV-26-1, E-45-1, PV-45-1, E-45-2, CHV-45-1, E-45-3, BV-45-1, P-45-1, P-47-1, CHV-47-1 and GV-47-2, and every item on the path has a datasheet. The heat exchangers E-7-2, E-26-1, E-45-1, E-45-2 and E-45-3 (Alfa Laval M3, FG frame) are rated 10.3 barg (150 psig) to ASME or 16.0 barg (232 psig) to PED. The pumps P-26-1, P-26-2, P-26-3, P-45-1 and P-47-1 (Gorman-Rupp) are rated 250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, with 266 psi (1834 kPa) maximum casing pressure, valid up to 100 °F (37 °C). The ball valves LV-7-1, BV-26-1, LV-26-1 and BV-45-1 (Flowserve Worcester F51/F52) have no single maximum pressure; per their pressure/temperature chart they range from about 12 bar (Group 1.2 Class 150 at 250 °C) up to about 51.8 bar (Group 1.2 Class 300 at −30 °C), also limited by seat material. The globe valve PV-45-1 (Fisher ET) likewise has no single figure; its limit depends on the ASME class (CL150/300/600), PN rating (PN16–PN100 depending on variant) and packing (up to 1500 psig / 104 bar for graphite ULF packing). The check valves CHV-45-1 and CHV-47-1 (Swagelok) have no single figure either; working pressures range from 13.7 bar (8C) up to 6000 psig (413 bar) for CH4/CH8 at low temperature. The lowest maximum allowable pressure on the path belongs to GV-47-2, the solenoid valve, which is rated a maximum permissible pressure of only 6 bar gauge (working range 0.5–6 bar), and even that holds only up to 40 °C, with the permissible pressure falling between 40 and 50 °C and a hard stop at 50 °C. So GV-47-2 at 6 bar is the weakest item on the path.
